dataset_obj.versions_recorded_one: {{n}} version recorded — see the Versions tab
dataset_obj.versions_recorded_other: {{n}} versions recorded — see the Versions tab
dataset_obj.preview_rows: First {{shown}} rows{{of}}. Sorting, filtering and full paging use the table viewer.
dataset_obj.preview_note: A dataset is an object, not a path in a chat message: it carries its own identity, quality, lineage, and the list of runs that read it.
dataset_obj.quality_sub: A quick heuristic read of the data itself — not a full QC run. For real QC, use Run full QC.
dataset_obj.quality_noref: No resolvable reference — a data profile is not available for this dataset.
dataset_obj.quality_error: Profile not available — the profiler could not read this dataset.
dataset_obj.run_qc_tip: Run a full QC workflow on this dataset (e.g. FastQC + MultiQC) through BioMate and open its report
dataset_obj.qc_request: Run quality control (QC) on this dataset and generate a QC report.
dataset_obj.lineage_note: This dataset was written by a workflow run; the run is an object you can open, not a string in a description.
dataset_obj.lineage_note_noprov: This dataset was written by a workflow run; live provenance is no longer retained for this run.
dataset_obj.uploaded_input: Uploaded input — no upstream workflow produced this dataset.
dataset_obj.no_consumers: No runs are recorded as reading this dataset yet.
dataset_obj.consumers_note: When consumers are recorded, replacing a dataset becomes a decision with a visible blast radius rather than a silent change under a running analysis.
dataset_obj.no_versions: Version history is not available yet — only the current dataset is recorded.
dataset_obj.version_note_help: Version entries are append-only — a note records a re-derivation or sign-off without ever rewriting a prior entry.
dataset_obj.columns_future: Per-column profiling (type, % missing, distinct) is coming. For now, open the file in Jupyter or ask in chat to inspect columns.
dataset_obj.plot_future: No distributions to plot inline yet. Open the file in Jupyter/RStudio or ask in chat for a specific view.
dataset_obj.why_versions_body: A run records the exact version it consumed, so editing a file cannot change what a finished run means — and if a result looks wrong, you can see whether the input moved under it.
dataset_obj.one_version_only: Only one version of this file exists. Editing it, or a run writing to it, creates the next one.
dataset_obj.what_used_it: What used it, and what came out
dataset_obj.no_preview: No preview captured for this file yet.

data_hub.project_scoped: Data is project-scoped. Pick a project to browse its datasets, quality and lineage.

data_hub.select_dataset_hint: Pick a file from the tree to open it as an object — its quality profile, the runs that produced and consumed it, and its version history.

tab_tips.settings: Workflow-wide datasets and configuration that apply to every phase. Required ones must be set before you run.

tab_tips.after_run: Available after the run completes — outputs, findings, QC report, methods write-up, and citations.

step_view.title: Full step view
step_view.outputs_running: Outputs will appear here as the step runs.
step_view.outputs_none: This step produced no output files, or none were recorded.
step_view.caption_raw: Raw first: the summary above is derived from these bytes, and you can check it.
step_view.caption_rendered: Rendered by the evidence class resolved from the output itself — the same viewer used on every surface.
step_view.params_ran_with: Parameters this step actually ran with
step_view.no_params: No parameters were recorded for this step.
step_view.params_caption: Defaults are quiet; anything the project inherited or you overrode is marked. Where the run did not report an origin, the badge says "unknown" rather than guessing.
step_view.raw_unreadable: Raw bytes could not be read as text ({{error}}).
step_view.origin_not_reported: origin not reported by the run — shown honestly rather than guessed
